Local protected incident log buffer before central collectors
Minimum finance transaction/reporting dependencies; ICFR relevance requires customer scope

Central control/support only; customer operating authority retained
Canon authoritative records, minimum Pinakes/Semaphore discovery and source-rights enforcement; indexes rebuildable
10% planning accelerator throughput; core institutional records do not wait for full AI restoration
